The first public release of Inkwell, an offline desktop Markdown editor.

## Downloads

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.0.0/Inkwell-1.0.0-windows-x64-setup.exe) · [Portable ZIP](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.0.0/Inkwell-1.0.0-windows-x64-portable.zip) |
| Linux x64 | [Debian package](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.0.0/Inkwell-1.0.0-linux-x64.deb) · [AppImage](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.0.0/Inkwell-1.0.0-linux-x64.AppImage) |
| macOS | [Universal DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.0.0/Inkwell-1.0.0-macos-universal.dmg) |

Extract the entire Windows portable ZIP into a writable folder and run `Inkwell.exe`. Settings and recent items are kept alongside it in `data/`. Both Windows editions require Microsoft Edge WebView2. The installer can download the runtime when needed.

On Linux, make the AppImage executable before running it. On macOS, open the DMG and drag Inkwell to Applications.

The Windows builds have no Authenticode signature and the macOS build has no Apple notarization. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may prompt at first launch. [SHA-256 checksums](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.0.0/SHA256SUMS.txt) are available for all downloads.

## Highlights

- Live Markdown and source editing in the same document, with undo history preserved across modes.
- Tables, task lists, images, syntax-highlighted code, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams and links to document anchors.
- Resizable sidebar with a folder tree and document outline, plus separate recent file and folder histories.
- English and Ukrainian interface and offline spelling dictionaries.
- Configurable typography, palettes, keyboard shortcuts, autosave and focus modes.
